Yes—I can handle the outreach in this system and gather multiple estimates for you.

To get accurate quotes from local plumbers in Portland, I need a few details:

1) Address & location
- Full service address in Portland (street, ZIP). You can redact apartment number if you prefer, but ZIP and general address area are needed for travel and permit considerations.

2) Faucet & materials
- Do you already have the new faucet purchased? If yes:
  - Brand/model (or at least: pull-down / pull-out / standard, single-handle vs two-handle).
  - Is it replacing an existing faucet in the same spot (standard sink, no relocation)?
- Do you need the plumber to:
  - Supply the faucet?
  - Supply any additional parts (supply lines, shutoff valves, etc.)?

3) Existing setup
- Is there currently:
  - A working faucet that just needs swapping?
  - Any visible leaks or damage under the sink?
  - Garbage disposal connected to the sink? (yes/no)
  - Dishwasher connected to the same drain? (yes/no)

4) Access & special constraints
- House, condo, or apartment?
- Any building/HOA rules about work hours or insurance requirements?

5) Timing
- Urgency: emergency / same day / routine?
- Preferred date(s) (YYYY-MM-DD) and general time window:
  - Morning / afternoon / specific window like “09:00–12:00”.

6) Contact for quotes
- Name:
- Best phone:
- Email (so providers can include written estimates and confirmations):

Once you share these, I’ll submit a multi-provider plumbing quote request for a “new kitchen faucet installation” in Portland, then come back with a side-by-side comparison of the estimates and available time slots.</action>
